earlyCaptureContract.quotaMeaning: Existing permanent nextCompanionId allocator interval, positive safe integer earlyCaptureCount<=30, default1. General saves: transfers and legacy ID repair may consume/jump quota; never infer natural capture totals. Only fresh/no-PvP canonical measurement equates this interval with natural captures.
earlyCaptureContract.rng: Always one existing capture draw per boss before OR with guarantee; nonboss no capture draw. Full roster keeps ordinary35% release/soul policy.
earlyCaptureContract.persistence: Preserve monotone existing allocation marker, not current roster. Successful captures and external acquisitions advance it while safe; removing/restarting/reincarnating never resets it. No new save field or reconstruction of unknown legacy natural capture history.
earlyCaptureContract.validation: Exact21 parameter binding; historical17/20 remain valid only under versions1/2. New same-candidate screening/full first recorded journey pairing; do not assert equality to older XP/capture candidates.
earlyCaptureContract.allocatorSafety: Implemented safe exhausted MAX marker including positiveInfinity, all-ID-digit repair with original IDs preserved, local unsafe/duplicate allocation rejection before roster/material/lost removal, external s/r delivery accepted with saturated counter. Historical Round06 focused/registered943tests and independentCritic evidence preserved; new current-source AC/gates required. No new save field or natural-only counter.

targets.method: Population median sorts unreached after all observed times; deadline fraction always divides by all samples.

method.input: uniform=500ms; burst=20 hits/10s at 100ms; warm profiles receive 120s onboarding
method.ordering: tick to boundary, input, observe readiness, menu visit, observation/purchases/management; checkpoints after boundary actions
method.visits: 0 means choose immediately and manage/purchase at observation intervals; positive values require a scheduled visit
method.management: One action per visit: consume strongest target/weakest food; fuse first ID-ordered eligible pair; reincarnate first eligible ID, otherwise consume strongest/weakest to raise a candidate
method.choice: Choose first card, reroll policy attempts one paid reroll first. No PvP simulation.
method.ownership: chosenHero is accepted ownership, killedMonster is lifetime defeat; seen is visibility, capturedMonster is actual roster addition
method.eligibilityObservation: Sample after each engine call emitting a kill, level-up, capture or hero-ready event; before offers, rerolls, choices, purchases and roster management; and at periodic observation boundaries. Multiple events within one engine call share its returned state.
method.eligibilityLimit: First observed eligibility, not a continuous-time proof. A time-only condition that appears and disappears between observation boundaries without a relevant event may be missed; no universal maximum-delay guarantee.
method.damage: Exact emitted bigint damage including overkill; partyPower is raw production selected-party power, not effective DPS
method.resume: Completed seeds are fingerprinted and reused; interrupted seeds restart from initial fixture, never approximate pending attack/RNG state
method.inference: Modeled progression only; no claim about player fun, retention, Steam time, Electron E2E or observed human attention
